sources.title: RIL Q1 FY27 Financial and Operational Performance
RIL Shareholding Pattern as on June 30 2026
Reliance in focus after windfall tax cut and bond issue

claims.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated results show positive sequential movement on the same quarter-to-quarter basis consumed by the structured provider: gross revenue rose from Rs 325,290 crore in March 2026 to Rs 340,257 crore in June 2026, and PAT including share of associates/JVs rose from Rs 20,589 crore to Rs 23,196 crore. Year-on-year revenue and recurring earnings also grew. This independently supports a positive fundamentals direction without altering the provider raw score.

Current September 2026 references place Reliance near 22.2x trailing P/E and 1.53x P/B, but a conglomerate-wide sector benchmark is not consistently defined across sources. The ratios are verified, while the directional valuation implication remains benchmark-dependent.

June 2026 ownership is mixed: promoter holding increased to 50.48% from 50.00%, FII/FPI holding declined to about 17.2% from 18.67%, and mutual-fund holding increased to 10.11% from 9.78%. The filing is independently verified but does not establish a single institutional direction.

Fresh September reporting identifies a cut in windfall taxes on fuel exports, which is directionally supportive for a major fuel exporter, alongside a reported Rs 12,500 crore five-year bond raise. The combined near-term catalyst set is current but not uniformly directional across all businesses.

No independently verified company-specific adverse event shock was identified in the fresh RIL evidence reviewed. The windfall-tax change is supportive rather than an adverse shock; live market and volatility evidence remains the structured provider's responsibility.

limitations: Q1 FY27 results dated 17 July 2026 are used as the latest reported fundamentals, not as a fresh September catalyst.
Institutional ownership is based on the latest filed June 2026 quarter and is not a live fund-flow measure.
Reliance spans multiple businesses, so a single sector valuation benchmark is not treated as authoritative; the valuation direction remains BINARY_UNCERTAIN.
The bond transaction is supported by reputable reporting; the research bundle does not infer a positive or negative EDGE score from the financing event.
This bundle contains no manually created EDGE score, DES, Market Trust, BOT, probability, Decision Ladder, price zone, or recommendation.
